published_ranges._notes: PCL-based, home-compostable wood filament with very high wood content. Density, Vicat and HDT come from TDS v1.0 (20-07-2023); the TDS gives no print temperatures. Nozzle and bed values were recorded by the earlier run from the official page and were not re-read in R5. EU food-contact compliant (EC 1935/2004, EU 10/2011). Store below 15% RH and print from a dry box. No Bambu PCL preset exists, so Generic PLA is a stand-in and not confirmed. Wood fill: use a 0.6 or 0.8 mm nozzle, never 0.2/0.4.
